died.name: Edward Gibbon
died.desc: English historian and Member of Parliament

died.name: John Moore
died.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Corunna. Moore then spoke of his mother and some other people, including Lady Hester Stanhope, before dying
died.last_words: It is a great satisfaction to me to know we have beaten the French. I hope the people of England will be satisfied. I hope my country will do me justice.

died.name: Ma Barker
died.cause: to her son, Fred Barker, prior to their deaths in a shootout with the FBI

died.name: Susan Grace Kelly
died.cause: The 80-year-old woman in Armidale, New South Wales, was sitting with her daughter when she fell back dead after hearing a loud clap of thunder. Her last words were, "That was very close."

died.name: Albert Fish
died.desc: American serial killer, child rapist and cannibal
died.last_words: What a thrill it will be to die in the electric chair... the supreme thrill, the only one I haven't tried.

died.name: Bob Jones Sr.
died.desc: American evangelist, founder of Bob Jones University
died.cause: to his wife before entering semi-coma
died.last_words: Mary Gaston, get my shoes; I must go to preach.

born.name: Richard Savage
born.cause: unable to remember what he wanted to say to his keeper at Bristol Newgate Prison. The keeper found Savage dead the next morning
born.last_words: I have something to say to you, sir... 'Tis gone.

born.name: Vittorio Alfieri
born.last_words: Clasp my hand, my dear friend, I die!

born.name: George Kelly
born.last_words: My dear, before you kiss me goodbye, fix your hair. It's a mess.
